title: What Is Competing for My Attention?
headline: Who Has Your Attention?
tagline: Attention is the front door of transformation. Protect it.
seo_title: Who Has Your Attention? Psalm 46:10 and the Voices Forming You | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Not every voice is evil, but every voice is forming you. A reflection for men on Psalm 46:10, attention and the voices you let in each day.
verse_text: Be still, and know that I am God.

scriptures.text: Be still, and know that I am God.

items: Stillness is not inactivity.
It is surrender.
God often quiets us before He directs us.
Every day your heart is being discipled.
Every notification.
Every headline.
Every conversation.
Every podcast.
Every reel.
Every opinion.
Every fear.
Not every voice is evil.
But every voice is forming you.

blocks.text: The question isn’t whether you’re listening.
The question is: who has your attention?

items: Jesus repeatedly said, “Whoever has ears to hear….”
Everyone had ears.
Not everyone was listening.
Because hearing is more than receiving sound.
It is receiving truth deeply enough that it changes you.
What captures your attention…. shapes your thinking.
What shapes your thinking…. forms your desires.
What shapes your desires…. guides your decisions.
What guides your decisions…. becomes your life.
Listening isn’t merely information.
It is formation.
The first voice I usually hear each morning is….
The last voice before bed is….
The voice I trust most is….
Do those voices consistently move me toward Christ?
Attention is the front door of transformation.
Protect it.
